_readme: Coverage map for arXiv:2501.00710v2 -- 'The Space of augmented stability conditions', Daniel Halpern-Leistner and Antonios-Alexandros Robotis. Created for GitHub #1178.

THIS IS NOT A TRUST RECORD AND NOT A MINT SURFACE. It is a zero-claim map restricted to the two source sections used by the mass--Hom and moduli lanes: section 2.2 and section 2.5. formalization.yaml's source remains the Bridgeland 2007 record, and registry/bridgeland2007.json remains the only mint surface. Every status in this file is target.

Update ownership: the owner (Chris Dare) promotes statuses. Agents may add or correct coordinates, but a promotion requires the evidence fields enforced by the validator and formalized additionally requires explicit owner acceptance.

Provenance: metadata and submission history were checked against the arXiv abstract page on 2026-09-12. Section titles and statement numbering were read with pdftotext -layout from the pinned v2 PDF. No corpus extraction was used.
Numbering caution: v1 and v2 differ. In particular, v1 Theorem 2.31 is v2 Theorem 2.35. Coordinates in this file always mean v2.

source.title: The Space of augmented stability conditions
source.comments: 102 pages, 8 figures; v2 removes the appendix to a separate concomitant work and makes minor changes and improvements.

source.pdf_pin_caveat: The hash pins the artifact as served on 2026-09-12. arXiv PDFs may be re-rendered without a content change; the durable identity is (arxiv_id, version, version_submitted_utc, doi).

corpus_note.arxiv_version_in_corpus: not used as evidence by this map
corpus_note.mint_rule: No durable key in this repository may be derived from a corpus identifier or notebook slug. This file contains neither.
